scope: Read-only forensic comparison of the original archived 0.5B SFT run against the isolated four-GPU 0.5B linear run. No training or source was changed by this audit.

full_learning_rate_fit.logging_convention: The logged learning rate at optimizer step s corresponds to scheduler index t=s-1; step 1 is 0, step 21 is the 3e-4 peak.

original_reported.cuda_readme_value: 13.0; README does not distinguish driver maximum from wheel runtime; Torch cu128 indicates CUDA 12.8 build

software_and_hardware.original_version_evidence: Pinned reproduction README environment table; original library package state was not archived independently.
intentional_differences: Four NVIDIA H20 GPUs rather than one A800; accumulation 2 rather than 8 preserves global batch 64.
software_and_hardware.numeric_reproducibility_limit: DDP reductions, microbatch distribution/tail handling and hardware kernels can produce numerical differences; identical learning parameters and LR do not prove bitwise-identical weights or identical recall.

task_construction.train_shuffle: HF dataset shuffle seed 42; all examples retained; Trainer sampling seed 42
task_construction.validation_shuffle: shuffle(seed=42) followed by another shuffle(seed=42), matching the pinned source
task_construction.labeling: Training prompt and padding labels are masked; answer plus newline/EOS is supervised; left padding with EOS; final 512 token budget.

normalization.objective: Summed causal CE over unmasked answer labels divided by all tokens in the global accumulation group. Trainer world-size compensation cancels DDP gradient averaging.
normalization.evidence: Transformers 4.57.1 Trainer/Qwen2/ForCausalLMLoss implementation and root read of checkpoint-1692 training_args.bin.
normalization.runtime_checkpoint_args_inspection_scope: Root independently read trusted training_args.bin in the container; this audit does not claim a SHA for that file because it was not copied here.

validation_trajectory_comparison.interpretation: Training trajectory differences are observed even with matched recipe and LR. They are not assigned to hardware, DDP, Python version or any single cause by this audit.

limitations: The original README labels its schedule cosine, but every archived LR point proves actual linear; this new run follows the archived executable behavior.
Original exact base-model revision and resolved CUDA attention kernel were not archived; no bitwise reproduction claim is made.
The original run used one GPU; four GPUs were explicitly requested. Same global batch and token normalization do not guarantee identical reduction ordering or tail examples.
The source-defined custom cosine helper is unused; neither its 0.1 LR floor nor the earlier 1.5B cosine run is treated as the original schedule.
Overall original SID-level evaluation includes collisions: 3686 item IDs map to 3670 SID strings. Cold/collision-free subgroup metrics are separate downstream diagnostics.
This is a process audit, not proof of matching recommendation quality or statistical significance.

Some original settings (including microbatch 8 and one GPU) are reported by the pinned README; the full original command line and serialized TrainingArguments were not archived. Flag equality distinguishes source/default/report evidence from directly observed LR, steps, samples and losses.
